subject: maths
question: What is the amount (in ₹) on a sum of ₹5,120 at 15% per annum for 2(1)/(2) years, if the interest is compounded 10 monthly?
solution:
Given:

Principal = Rs 5120

Rate of interest = 15%

Time = 2(1)/(2) years = 2.5 years

Concept used:

In case of the compound interest,

Amount = P(1 + R/100)N

CI = P(1 + R/100)N - P

where

P = Principal amount

R = Rate of interest per year

N = Time in years

Calculation:

Since the interest in compounded 10-monthly,

Rate of interest (R) = (15 × 10/12) = 12.5%

Time (N) = (2.5 × 12/10) = 3

Now, the amount becomes

⇒ 5120 (1 + 12.5/100)³

⇒ 5120 (112.5/100)³

⇒ 5120 (1.125)³

⇒ Rs. 7290

∴ The amount will be Rs. 7290.
